name: Cyber Thuban
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 "Cyber" Spell/Trap from your GY. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 Machine "Cyber" monster from your Deck to your hand, except "Cyber Thuban". If this card is sent to the GY: You can activate this effect; your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when you Special Summon a Level 10 LIGHT Machine monster(s) this turn. You can only use each effect of "Cyber Thuban" once per turn.
